question: The Delhi sultan, who succumbed to injuries as a result of his fall from horse was _____.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Qutubuddin Aibak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Qutubuddin Aibak**

 
 
• Qutbuddin Aibak was the slave of Muhammad Ghori.
 
• He was a **Turkish slave** by origin after the death of Ghori, he became the master of Hindustan and founded the Slave Dynasty in 1206 AD.
 
• He was given the title of **Lakh Baksh **(giver of lakhs).
 
• He died in 1210 AD while playing *Chaugan *or horse polo.
 
• He constructed two mosques, Quwwat-ul- Islam in Delhi and Adhai din ka Jhonpra in Ajmer.
 
• He also began the construction of **238 feet high stone** tower Qutub Minar, in honour of the famous Sufi Saint, Khwaja Qutubuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki.
 
• He patronised writers like Hasan-ul Nizami, author of Taj-ul-Massir and Fakhruddin, author of Tarikh-i-Mubarak Shahi
 
• Dynasty ended when Jalal Ud din Firuz Khilji overthrew the last Mamluk ruler Muiz ud din Qaiqabad in 1290.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Razia Sultan was the first female Sultan of India in 1236.

 
 
• She was known as an efficient and just ruler.
 
• She ruled in Delhi from 1236 to 1240.
 
• She succeeded her father Shams-ud-din Iltutmish and turned into the Sultanate of Delhi.
 
 
 
• Shams ud-din Iltutmish was the third ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
 
• Iltutmish, a "**slave of a slave**" is regarded by several historians as the real founder and consolidator of the slave dynasty and the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• He was the slave and the successor of Qutubbuddin Aibak.
 
• He launched the silver tanka and the copper Jital as the regular currency.
 
• Iltutmish started the system of Iqtadari.
 
• Chahalgani or chalisa was formed by Iltutmish.
 
• He was the first to make Delhi the capital.
 
 
 
• Sultan Ghiyas-ud-din Balban ascended the throne of Delhi after the death of Sultan Nasiruddin in 1266 A.D.
 
 
• In his early life, he served as a **slave of Iltutmish and was included among the "famous Forty**" i.e. **Chahalgani or Chalisa.**
 
 

**​​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 __**Ruler**__
 __**Place in History**__
 
 

 Iltutmish
 
 
 
• 1210-36 AD.
 
• Son-in-law of Qutab-ud-din-Aibak.
 
• Formed Turkan-i-Chahalgani or Chalisa (group of 40 nobles).
 
• Introduced Silver Tanka and Copper Jittal.
 
• Built Sultan Garhi tomb (first Muslim tomb, because of which Iltutmish is called the father of Tomb building).
 
 
 
 

 Behram Shah
 
 
 
• Bahram Shah succeeded his half-sister Razia Sultan (while she was imprisoned by subedar Malik Altunia).
 
• He was succeeded by his nephew Alauddin Masud Shah (son of his half-brother Rukn ud din Firuz).
 
 
 
 

 Balban
 
 
 
• 1266-86 AD.
 
• Introduced Sijda and Paibos system (a way to greet the sultan).
 
• Excluded non-Turks from the administration.
 
• Iron and blood policy.
